parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page to return. Minimum value: 1. Default value: 1.

parameters.name: EventName
parameters.description:
The alerting name. Valid values:
- ALL: all Alarm Metric values.

parameters.name: IdList
parameters.description:
The event ID.

><notice>This field is deprecated.></notice>.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language of the request and response. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:
- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return per page in a paging query. Default value: 20.

parameters.name: Source
parameters.description: The business source. This parameter can be left empty. Default value: agentless.
